name: Being Rude
overview: Scripture teaches that rude or harsh words provoke anger, whereas gentle and thoughtful speech can defuse conflict, as Proverbs 15:1 illustrates. Philippians 2:3 calls believers to humility, urging them to value others above themselves and avoid actions motivated by selfish ambition or strife. Furthermore, James 4:17 reminds us that knowing the right thing to do and failing to do it is sin, emphasizing personal responsibility to respond with kindness rather than rudeness.
